verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub examples show developers can install individual plugins/skill-bundles from a marketplace (e.g. `/plugin install document-skills@anthropic-agent-skills` vs `example-skills@anthropic-agent-skills`, or `quality-review-plugin@my-plugins`) rather than pulling the entire marketplace, and the API lets you specify individual `skill_id`s per request rather than a whole bundle. Missing for 10: no evidence of picking a single skill out of a multi-skill plugin bundle, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this selective install granularity in practice.
